exercises.q: Did you have a look inside?
exercises.why: **заглядывал** — загля́дывать (imperfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: заглянуть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **заглядывай** — загля́дывать (imperfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: заглянуть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **выглядывай** — выгля́дывать (imperfective): to look out, to peep out; to appear, to emerge, to come into view.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at
to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at something
to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at)
to cast a glance (from time to time)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: огляну́ться — to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at; огля́дываться — to look / glance back (at); to turn (back) to look at something; загляну́ть — to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); погля́дывать — to cast a glance (from time to time).

exercises.q: Don't look into the abyss. Otherwise, the abyss will gaze into you.
exercises.ru: Не смотри в бездну. Иначе бездна будет ___ в тебя.
exercises.why: **вглядываться** — вгля́дываться (imperfective): to peer into, to look or observe narrowly.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Martha stared at her deeply, as if peering into her soul.
exercises.ru: Марта пристально на неё смотрела, словно ___ в душу.
exercises.why: **вглядываясь** — вгля́дываться (imperfective): to peer into, to look or observe narrowly.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **оглядывал** — огля́дывать (imperfective): to examine, to inspect, to look over. Wiktionary: огляде́ть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **выглянул** — вы́глянуть (perfective): to look out, to peep out; to appear, to emerge, to come into view. Wiktionary: вы́- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
